_schema: What CUORE must capture at every scan of this platform, as an explicit checked list. Each row: id; label; why (one sentence tied to the open EVAP job); source (legislated | uds | did | bundle | mes_sync | mechanic_input); evidence_kind (an object naming the observation kind in the live store that proves capture, the named checker in cuore/services/scan_requirements_bridge.py, and its parameters; 'step' optionally names the fullscan step whose failure explains an absent observation; 'window' is 'scan' (default: the scan's own time window) or 'after_start' (anything recorded since the scan began); not_capturable_reason is only on mechanic_input rows, which are never checked, only listed as 'needs mechanic'. Marque and car specifics live here, not in code.

platform.name: 2018 Alfa Romeo Stelvio 2.0T Q4 (GME-T4, Marelli IAW 10JA)
platform.open_job: EVAP: P0440 / P0455 / P0456 on a sealed system (job 76d3454bce75)

requirements.label: Readiness since clear (Mode 01 PID 01)
requirements.why: Shows whether the EVAP monitor has completed since the last clear, which decides if a P0440 status byte of 0xCD is a fresh failure or a leftover.

requirements.label: Mode 06 EVAP tests 0x3A (0.090 in) and 0x3C (0.020 in)
requirements.why: The 0.090 in and 0.020 in leak-test values (404 ms vs min 3965 ms on 2026-10-13) are the only numbers that separate a real leak from a switch that never reports vacuum.

requirements.label: PIDs 46, 2F, 42, 1F, 30, 31 (ambient, fuel, voltage, run time, warm-ups, distance since clear)
requirements.why: These are the EVAP monitor's enabling conditions and the invalid-input check for hypothesis 8c659dfc (ambient and fuel level reaching the ECM over CAN).

requirements.label: Stored, pending and permanent codes (Modes 03, 07, 0A)
requirements.why: A pending or permanent P0440 after a clear shows whether the lamp request is still owed, and the 2026-10-19 00:39 clear left no post-clear read to say.

requirements.label: Mode 09 calibration ID and CVN (PIDs 04, 06)
requirements.why: The calibration ID and CVN say which ECM calibration is on the car, which the TSB 18-026-20 and 18-030-17 flash question depends on.

requirements.label: ECM DTCs with status bytes (UDS 19 02)
requirements.why: The ECM status bytes (P0440 0xCD, P0455 and P0456 0x4D on 2026-10-19) are the lamp-request and test-completion evidence for the open EVAP codes.

requirements.label: EVAP bundle: decoded snapshots for P044x / P045x
requirements.why: The freeze-frame snapshot (fuel level, coolant, rpm, MAP at the moment each EVAP code set) is erased by a clear, and the 2026-10-19 store copy was the only one left.

evidence_kind.applies_when: ECM holds an active EVAP code (P044x / P045x / P046x with an active status bit)

requirements.label: ECM identity DIDs F188, F194, F187
requirements.why: The ECM software numbers (52170619 / P235QB39) prove whether the calibration changed between scans, which is the C7 calibration branch of the EVAP diagnosis.

requirements.label: Battery and IBS DIDs: BCM 1004, BCM 1005, ECM 19BD
requirements.why: Supply voltage and IBS state of charge test the marginal-supply theory (H-B) that could abort the EVAP monitor mid-test; all three are catalogued but not yet read.

requirements.label: BCM DTCs with status bytes, incl. U-codes (UDS 19 02)
requirements.why: BCM U1713-2F (ECM signal erratic) has been live in the same cycle as most EVAP returns and is the lead in the CAN-input branch (C8, C10).

requirements.label: MES clear sync (MultiEcuScan clears recorded on the job)
requirements.why: A clear done in MultiEcuScan lives only in its log, and an unrecorded clear makes a clean re-read look like a repair (11 ECM clears in 53 days).

evidence_kind.note: mes_clear_watch.sync() stamps synced_at only when it finds a new MES log, so a gap can also mean there was nothing new to sync

requirements.label: ESIM switch state while hand vacuum is applied
requirements.why: Whether the switch ever closes, holds and reopens under vacuum is the single reading that splits the ESIM and its wiring from a blockage or the ECM (wiTECH Test A).
requirements.not_capturable_reason: No DID is known for the switch state (esim_status is a non-pollable placeholder and the ESIM function is a 0x31 RoutineControl that CUORE refuses); read it in wiTECH or across the switch circuit with a meter, then record it.

requirements.label: ESIM switch-wire voltage under vacuum
requirements.why: Reference voltage, ground and the switch wire's voltage change under vacuum separate a dead switch (C5) from a wiring or ECM input fault (C6) in wiring test B1 to B5.
requirements.not_capturable_reason: Needs a meter at the ESIM connector (driver-side rear wheel liner); no OBD or UDS channel carries the switch-wire voltage.

requirements.label: ESIM mounting orientation and part number
requirements.why: The ESIM was swapped on 2026-09-02 and P0440 was back 2.2 days later, but its orientation (it should mount vertically) and part number (04861961AD vs 04861959xx) were never recorded.
requirements.not_capturable_reason: Visual check of the fitted unit and its label against the parts catalogue; the part cannot be read electronically.

requirements.label: SLVT (small leak verification test) result
requirements.why: TSB 18-048-23 says a road test cannot confirm a small-leak repair, so a clean SLVT is the only proof of fix for P0456 and has never been run.
requirements.not_capturable_reason: SLVT runs only in wiTECH; CUORE's replica at /slvt records a result the mechanic enters.
